doc.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023

title: Bjork's live first take with a big band
summary: Bjork arrived late in a three hour session but the live first take had excitement.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Because I saw that anecdote about the three hour orchestral session with Bjork that she showed up at the last ten minutes or something and I can imagine that was a pretty tense situation with all those people sitting there and the clock running.

It was but the amazing thing, obviously, because it’s you know her singing live with a big band, first take. It’s got that excitement of a first take with a big band. And there’s no way — well there’s no way we could have done it as a backing track with her singing on top of it, but also six takes and the whole level of excitement would have gone right
down. So it was lucky in the end, although I could do without the showing up ten minutes from the end.
